body: I want to get the second piece up to 100 bpm by the end of the month.
Evenings are the best time for me to practise.
I play a classical guitar, nothing electric.
Actually mornings work better for practice now, evenings are too busy.
I keep a small herb garden on the balcony.
Please always keep answers short when I'm on the phone.
